paite: Ngaiin, TOUPAN lei a awngsakin, a sesak sina, a lumlet dinga, a omte a dalhsak sin hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

paite: Huan, vantang tunga om bangin siampu tungah leng a om ding; bawipa tunga a om bangin a pu tungah leng a om ding; bawinu tung a om bangin a pi tungah leng a om ding; a leimi tunga a om bangin, a khawngmi tungahleng a om ding; leitawisakmi tunga a om bangin a kianga apung pemi tungah leng a om ding.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

paite: Lei lah awnsak keuhkeuh inleh hih siat dimdemin a om ding; huai lah TOUPAN a chita ngala.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

paite: Lei lah a kapin a tul a khovel lah bahin a tul a, leia mi tungnungte a bah uhi.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

paite: Lei lah a ommite nuaiah a buahkhinta; dan te ah a talek ua, thuseh lak a hihlamdang ua, khantawn thukhuna a tatlek jiak un.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

paite: Huaijiakin hamsiatin lei a ne khina, a ommite lah siam louh tansak in a omta uh: huaijiakin leia ommite lah a kanglum ua, mi tawm chik kia a om lai uh.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

paite: Uain thak lah a kapa, grepgui lah a baha, lungtang nuamte tengteng a mau uhi.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

paite: Khuangtate kipahna lah a daia, kaihging nuamsa ging lah a daita.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

paite: Lasa kawmin uai a dawm kei ding uh: ju lah a dawnmite adingin a kha mahmah ding.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

paite: Buaina khopi chipsakin a omta: kuamah himhim a lut louhnba ding un in chih khakin a omta.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

paite: Uain jiakin kongzingte ah kap husa a oma: nuamna tengteng mialsakin a oma, hiai gam nopna a gamgta.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

paite: Khopi ah siatna nutsiatin a oma, a kulh kongkhak lah vuak siatin a omta.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

paite: Lei laitakah mi chih lakah hichiin a om sing ngala, olive sing vuak nunga gah a om lai sek bangin leh, grep loh nunga grep maih loh ding a om lai sek bang maiin.
english: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

paite: Huaiten a aw uh a suah ding ua, a kikou ding uh; TOUPA thupina jiakin tuipi akipanin ngaihtakin a kikou ding uh.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

paite: Huaijiakin TOUPA tuh Suahlam ah pahtawi un.
english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

paite: Kawlmong tawpa lasak i ja, Mi diktatte kiangah thupina om hen, chih la. Himahleh, ken bel, Ka gawng huaihuaia, ka tung gik hi! lepchiahtaka gamtammiten lepchiahtakin a hih uhi, ka chi a.
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

paite: Leia om aw, lauhuainate, kokhukte, thangte na tungah a om hi.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.

paite: Huchiin hichi ahi dinga, lauhuai husa akipana taipa tuh kokhukah a ke dinga; kokhuk sunga kipana pawtkhe toumi thangah a awk ding; tunglama tohlette lah honin a om ngalam lei kingaknate lah a ling hi.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

paite: Lei lah a kitam gawp veka, lei lah hihmanin a om vek a, lei lah nak pitakin a ling hi.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

paite: Leilah mi zukham bangin a hoi dongdong dinga, bawkta hawt bangin a kihawt ding; a tatlekna lah a tungah giktakin a om ding a, huchiin a puk dinga, a thou nawnta kei ding hi.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

paite: Huan, huai ni chiangin hichi ahi dinga, Toupan tunglama mi tungnung pawl lian pipite a gawt ding, leia lei kumpipate toh.
english: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

paite: Huan, hentate kokhuka pi khawma a om bang un huaite pi khawmin a om ding ua, suangkulha khum in a om ding uh, ni sawttak nungin gawt in a om ding uh.Huai hun chiangin tunga kha zum takin a om dinga, tunga ni zahlak takin a om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem khuaah leh, a upate maah, thupitakin lalin a om sing ngala.
english: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

paite: Huai hun chiangin tunga kha zum takin a om dinga, tunga ni zahlak takin a om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem khuaah leh, a upate maah, thupitakin lalin a om sing ngala.
english: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.
